description: Live password validation. 'fields' are merged onto a valid generated user (nickname 'amielnoy'). 'errors' must all be visible and every other known password error hidden. 'submitBlocked': submit and assert the user stays on signup. Never true for an accepted password, since submitting would create an account. Observed on canary: strength is scored against the nickname/email, so a password containing the nickname is weak.
